name: t3_opaque_quota
description: Insufficient/honest opaque quota: the fixture tells the strategy a generous remaining figure via QuotaSnapshotTold, but the window's true headroom (already consumed by an earlier real, world-visible spend) is far smaller. Proves the world and the told snapshot are never the same thing, and that World::true_occupancy, not the told figure, is what PR-B's verifier must trust.
